name: bernoulliFun_mul
statement: ℕ) {m : ℕ} (m0 : m ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) : bernoulliFun k (m * x) = m ^ k / m * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, bernoulliFun k (x + i / m)

name: hasSum_one_div_nat_pow_mul_sin
statement: ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * k + 1) * Real.sin (2 * π * n * x)) ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * (2 * π) ^ (2 * k + 1) / 2 / (2 * k + 1)! * (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k + 1))).eval x)
